class.name: RosPublisher
class.brief_description: A ROS 2 Publisher for sending messages to a topic.
class.description: [RosPublisher] allows Godot to send [RosMsg] data to other ROS 2 nodes. It is created through [method RosNode.create_publisher] and is tied to a specific topic and message type.

method.name: publish
method.description: Publishes the data contained in [param msg] to the associated topic. The [RosMsg] type must match the type specified when the publisher was created.
